(3) Requesting PII (full name, email, phone number) in a chat interface under the guise of 'background verification' is a common phishing/scam tactic. (4) Legitimate LinkedIn recruiter communications would occur through official LinkedIn channels, not external domains. (5) The urgency and request for sensitive contact information in a chat is suspicious. This is a phishing attempt designed to harvest personal information.
